title: LedgeX source pack (P26)
description: Every jurisdictions/<pack>/sources.yaml validates against this. Field shapes mirror db/schema.sql's real source/field_definition tables directly, not an independently-invented shape -- see prompts/P26-jurisdictions-pack-format.md for the full argument. supplies: is this file's own name for what the live schema calls source.expected_fields (jsonb array) -- same list, different name because 'supplies' reads better in a source-authored-by-a-human pack file than the database's own storage-shaped column name.

jurisdiction.description: Must equal a real jurisdiction.id row -- checked by make conformance, not by this schema alone (JSON Schema cannot see the database).

pack_version.description: "<jurisdiction>@<semver>" -- §7.1's own literal example is "ca_san_jose@0.1.0". Deliberately NOT the same value as jurisdiction.pack_version in the database (currently 'v1.0', a different, coarser versioning scheme for a different column) -- not conflated here.

portals.description: Human-facing landing pages, informational only -- never read by any loader or conformance check. Not source endpoints (those live per-source, in each source's own endpoint_url).

id.description: Must equal a real source.id row when phase_status is 'active' -- checked by make conformance. Non-active entries may name a source with no database row yet (declared, not fabricated -- §7.1's own 'recorded so the exclusion is a decision, not an oversight').

method.description: Mirrors the live access_method enum (0001) exactly -- five values, not independently chosen.

licence.description: Must name an id declared in this pack's own sibling licences.yaml. Must equal a real licence.id row when phase_status is 'active' -- checked by make conformance.

phase_status.description: Mirrors the live source_phase_status enum (0001) exactly.

supplies.description: field_key values this source provides -- source.expected_fields, by this file's own name for it. Every entry must exist in field_definition, and the full list must exactly match the live source row's expected_fields, when phase_status is 'active' -- both checked by make conformance, neither checkable by JSON Schema alone.

active.description: Only ever meaningfully false here -- I14: portal/manual sources can never be active (source_active_requires_machine_access). A source pack entry does not itself activate anything; the live source.active column is the only runtime authority (§7.3).

excluded.description: true only for phase_status: excluded entries -- a source removed from the stack entirely (e.g. Sanborn-encumbered county building footprints), not merely gated. Redundant with phase_status: excluded by construction; kept as its own field because §7.1's own drafted text uses it that way.
